review_notes: Ledger F-60 record: corpus cited commit cfb6444c8 (known IF-001 mis-citation); a second mis-citation (cd7653855, PR #1306, titled with F-60/F-92 but its actual diff touches only query_temporal_activation.ts + register_d9_judgment.ts) was found and ruled out this session. The real, still-open defect was independently re-confirmed directly on origin/main: get_strength.ts line 111 silently capped `limit` to 2000 via Math.min, and line 214 reported `total: servedRows.length` -- a post-cap/post-offset/post-all:false-filter page length masquerading as a true row count. Fix: (1) restructured the WHERE-clause + params construction to be shared between a new dedicated COUNT(*) query and the existing SELECT, so a genuine pre-LIMIT/OFFSET row count (matching chart_id/categories/ayanamsha_id/graha_key) is surfaced as a new `total_available` field, independent of pagination/cap/the all:false counterfactual-row drop; (2) recorded the caller's original requested limit before capping and added explicit `limit_capped`/`requested_limit`/`note_limit_cap` disclosure whenever the 2000-row hard cap is actually hit, instead of silently truncating. `total` field's name and page-length meaning were left unchanged (additive-only) after confirming, via targeted grep across platform/ and platform-mcp/, that no downstream caller reads `total` as a true count: graha_portrait.ts and query_planet.ts (the only two other in-repo callers of getStrengthCapability.handler) destructure only `.rows`; register_p1_ganita.ts's ganita_strength_get MCP tool wrapper calls envelope(data, 'ganita_strength_get') with no `pagination` argument at all, so the wire-level pagination.total the MCP client sees was already null/unrelated to this field pre-fix. No other test file, snapshot, or type contract in the repo asserts get_strength's exact response-key set. Independent review pass confirms the diff is additive-only and does not change any existing field's name, type, or meaning.
